Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vimla - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Isha - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Ananya - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bedroom. Meenakshi and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aditya (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Aditya sits on the edge of the bed.]

Meenakshi: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Aditya stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi, Vimla and Isha stand near him.]

Vimla: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya opens his umbrella.]

Aditya (gently): "That was fun!"

[Aditya puts on his raincoat.]

Isha: "I really enjoyed today."
